defect_root_cause: No obvious defect was found in the local TTL, expiration-boundary, capacity-eviction, or entry-lifecycle behavior shown. The implementation does not provide distributed replication or cross-node coordination.

eviction_analysis.eviction_strategy: LRU; successful reads and writes place an entry at the most-recently-used end.
eviction_analysis.eviction_trigger: Before inserting, expired entries are purged and least-recently-used entries are removed until there is room.
eviction_analysis.expired_entry_precedence: Expired entries are purged before capacity eviction, so they take precedence over live entries as removal candidates.

boundary_case_results.case_description: An entry is written with a zero-second TTL and then read.
boundary_case_results.expected_behavior: The entry is expired immediately and the read returns a miss.
boundary_case_results.actual_behavior: The read compares the deadline with the current monotonic time using <=, deletes the entry, and returns a miss.

boundary_case_results.case_description: At capacity, an expired entry is not the least-recently-used entry when a new key is written.
boundary_case_results.expected_behavior: Purge the expired entry before evicting any live LRU entry.
boundary_case_results.actual_behavior: The write purges all entries with deadlines at or before the captured time before checking whether capacity eviction is needed.

boundary_case_results.case_description: A read and write for the same cache instance overlap across threads.
boundary_case_results.expected_behavior: The operations should observe a serialized state transition without corrupting recency or entry contents.
boundary_case_results.actual_behavior: Both operations hold the instance RLock while accessing the ordered mapping, so their state changes are serialized.

ttl_expiration_analysis.ttl_value_or_source: Each write supplies its own ttl_seconds value; negative TTLs are rejected, while zero is allowed.
ttl_expiration_analysis.expiration_basis: An absolute per-entry deadline computed from the write-time monotonic clock. Reads do not extend the deadline.
ttl_expiration_analysis.boundary_operator: deadline <= now; an entry is expired at the exact deadline.

entry_lifecycle_analysis.lifecycle_summary: A write validates its TTL, purges expired entries, replaces any existing value for the key, evicts LRU entries if necessary, and stores a new deadline. A successful read refreshes recency; an expired requested entry is deleted and returned as a miss.
entry_lifecycle_analysis.expiration_cleanup_behavior: Lazy cleanup on reads for the requested key, plus a full expired-entry sweep before each write. No background cleanup is used.

distributed_cache_risk_analysis.risk_summary: The lock protects only this process-local instance. Independent nodes can hold different values or eviction orders, and monotonic deadlines are not portable across processes, so this implementation alone does not ensure distributed consistency.
distributed_cache_risk_analysis.affected_scenario: Multiple application nodes maintain separate instances for the same logical keys, or an entry and its monotonic deadline are transferred to another process.
